candidate.answerReason: Reflecting across the vertical line puts the purple square at the upper right, the longer crossbar arm toward the upper left, and the stem toward the lower left. These features identify B.

methods.label: Track the reflected features
methods.explanation:
[Figure 1](figures/1989_AMC_8_Q11_question_fig1.svg)

Imagine folding the picture across the vertical line at its left. A reflection across a vertical line reverses left and right while keeping each point at the same height.

The purple square therefore moves from the upper left of the frame to the upper right. From the junction of the T, the longer crossbar arm originally points toward the upper right, so its reflection points toward the upper left. The stem originally points toward the lower right, so its reflection points toward the lower left.

Choices A and C have the square in the correct corner but have incorrect arm directions. Choices D and E put the square in the wrong corner. Choice B has all the required features.

[Figure 3](figures/1989_AMC_8_Q11_choiceB_fig3.svg)

The answer is choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
